groups.defect: The local cache entry is set before the DB write, so a device rejected with ErrDeviceLimitReached is cached and gets through the limit on its next request.
groups.rationale: Both point at the same impl.go lines and propose the same fix: cache only after the write succeeds, or delete the key on error.

groups.defect: CountDevices followed by insert is a non-atomic check-then-act (TOCTOU), so concurrent new devices can push the count past device_limit.
groups.rationale: Same race at the same database.go lines, with the same suggested fix: make the limit check atomic.

groups.defect: Authenticate now calls TagDevice synchronously on the request context instead of in a best-effort goroutine, so every anonymous auth waits on COUNT+UPDATE/INSERT and can be cancelled or fail; callers also aren't updated for the new refusal case.
groups.rationale: Both flag the async-to-sync change in client.go and its latency/blocking cost. s_3a7464c4 adds the caller-contract and refusal-handling angle.

groups.defect: Provider signature changes (ProvideAnonymousDeviceService now takes db.DB instead of AnonStore; ProvideAnonDBStore needs deviceLimit) leave the wire/DI bindings for AnonStore and any remaining callers stale, so DI or compilation breaks.
groups.rationale: Both report the same DI/wire breakage from this refactor: the AnonStore provider binding wasn't updated. One fix to the wire definitions resolves both.
